pages.title: Wildness on Signal
pages.text: Creature reactions can be used in controlled devices.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: A desert Guster eye makes a redstone blower. Interrupt dangerous Skreecher calling to obtain its soul for the sculk-triggered boomer; redstone can disable it.
